title.narrative: Enterprises, MSMEs, social and solidarity economy (SSE) entities and value chains benefit from improved productivity, sustainability and innovations for just transitions and decent work

description.narrative: The CPO focusses on enabling socially responsible and sustainable businesses including large enterprises, Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs), Social and Solidarity Economy (SSE) entities and their value chains to benefit from improved productivity, sustainability, entrepreneurship, and innovations. Support is provided for setting or strengthening policy coordination mechanisms to engage with relevant government entities and social partners on supply chains, trade and investment policies with the view to improving policy coherence and effectiveness. This is done through engagement, capacity building and knowledge sharing with the constituents, and supporting the better use of operational tools and principles of the Multinational Enterprises (MNE) Declaration to address responsible business conduct as well as work on developing local/sectoral initiative. The other focus area involves supporting revitalisation of the economy through the development of MSMEs, cooperatives and SSE. Special emphasis is placed on the connection between farm and enterprise development for decent job creation, as well as cluster and value chain development. Formalizing the informal economy, especially the informal enterprises and supporting the social solidarity economy, promoting just transition and green businesses for job creation and responsible practices or human-centred business practises by MNEs, and social dialogue process are integral to the CPO strategy. ILO is a partner in Partnership for Action on Green Economy (PAGE). ILO’s activities within that focus on employment aspects of greening, how to define and measure green jobs in the India context, ensuring that these jobs meet Decent Work standards, which includes assessing the supporting policy ecosystem and supporting a Just Transition towards a green economy that protects the workforce that may be negatively impacted by greening.
